title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
source: This is a matrix recording using two sources: SBD Reel shnid 124067: TASCAM 22-2 modified for flat transfer. Reel-> Tascam 22-2 -> Tascam MKII DR-07 (24-bit, 96kHz) - DC8Forensics for editing and modification and Audience shnid 000733: Reel>PCM>Dat>Tascam DA20>Audio Magic Presto>Prodif Plus>Soundforge>cdwav>shn

ai_review.summary: High‑quality matrix recording of a tight, compact set highlighted by He Was a Friend, Doin’ That Rag, Me & My Uncle and a smoking Cryptical > Other 1 > Cryptical sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its concise, well‑flowing performance with standout versions of “He Was a Friend of Mine,” “Doin' That Rag,” and the classic “Me & My Uncle.” Reviewers also note an especially tight Cryptical > Other 1 > Cryptical (Cryptical Reprise) run and Jerry Garcia’s picking‑up‑the‑pace guitar work. The matrix source provides good, clear sound that lets these moments shine.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are overwhelmingly positive about both the performance and the audio; the show is described as a tight set with multiple standout songs, and the recording quality is noted as good.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers comment on “Good sound” and a clean capture of the compact set; no major drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: A concise, well‑sequenced set that closes strongly with “Me & My Uncle”; the Cryptical/Other 1 transition is highlighted as particularly tight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s playing picking up speed and delivering beautifully developed guitar solos.
